test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits third to the left of F. C sits second to the left of D. Only F sits between A and C. G is not an immediate neighbour of B. How many people sit between A and D when counted from the left of D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

C sits second to the left of D.

Only F sits between A and C.

B sits third to the left of F.

G is not an immediate neighbour of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4709fc4a1d028e97bca550ba1d82b931ee1978333487a5eadfb3b9cd8547137.png] 

And E sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a299dd36dd2ad6ec6d3a8c2a105ff04506219848073e8fb3d845ed1f4f036fb.png] 

Thus, three people sit between A and D when counted from the left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
